[[File:Mr. Matthews.png|thumb|250px|Mr. Matthews]] '''Mr. Matthews''' (Japanese: '''マシュー''' ''Matthew'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW038|Movie Time! Zorua in "The Legend of the Pokémon Knight"!]]''. Mr. Matthews is the owner of a movie theater and [[Luke]]'s mentor. He allowed Luke to watch films in the theater for free in exchange that he helped out with the projection of the film. Later, after [[Luke's Zorua]] ran away, Mr. Matthews was introduced to {{Ash}} and {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} informed Luke that Zorua had fled inside the theater. After Zorua and Luke reconciled, Matthews allowed Luke and his new friends use the theater's storage rooms to prepare props and costumes. At the end of the episode, he suggested that Luke compete in the [[Club Battle]] tournament being held in [[Nimbasa Town]] to help him gain experience in competitive battling in order to make the scenes in his movies more intense.
